data.description: The herald has a 20-foot-radius emanation equivalent to a Desecrate spell centered on a shrine of evil power.  Undead within this radius (including the Maw) gain a +2 profane bonus on attack and damage rolls and saving throws, as well as +2 hit points per die, and the save DC of channeled negative energy is increased by +6 (these adjustments are included for the Maw in its entry).  This aura can be negated by Dispel Evil, but the herald can reactivate it on its turn as a free action.  A desecrating aura suppresses and is suppressed by Consecrate or Hallow; both effects are negated within any overlapping area of effect.
data.name: Desecrate Aura
